scientific_integrity: A derived second-moment theorem for a path functional of an explicitly defined active particle, independently checked against finite numerical ODE integration and Monte Carlo; no external validation or limiting distribution is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The nonreset cumulative propulsion observable differs from relocated physical position.
A full weak limit and higher moments are not proved.
An equivalent reinforced-telegraph calculation in less-indexed literature remains possible.
title: Hidden propulsion transition in a historical-velocity-reset active walker
